PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 8, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  SPECIAL MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-57320  Recommendation to approve December 10, 2025, and December 18, 2025 Board
  meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

2.  26-57321  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary, including any Terms of Services, to amend Purchase Order No.
  22602260 with ConvergeOne Inc., to provide temporary integrated, cloud-based
  telephony and collaboration services in support of the Department’s
  communication needs, to increase the contract amount by $60,000 and extend the
  term to October 26, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-57322  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute the National
  Mutual Assistance Agreement (NMAA) developed by the American Gas
  Association (“AGA”), the American Public Gas Association (“APGA”), the Northeast
  Gas Association (“NGA”), the Southern Gas Association (“SGA”), the Midwest
  Energy Association (“MEA”), and Western Energy Institute (“WEI”) to provide and
  request emergency assistance to and from participating members of the
  associations for the period of January 1, 2026, through December 31, 2030.

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 8, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-57399  Recommendation to receive and file the December 18, 2025 Infrastructure
  Committee Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

CLOSED SESSION

26-57324  Pursuant to Paragraph (b) (1) of Section 54957 of the California Government Code
  regarding Public Employee Performance Evaluation: General Manager

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than
72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call
the Board of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-
6626 (telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
